links.outcome: Readability indices, PEMAT understandability/actionability, and GQS of LLM patient education responses
links.effect: Readability differed significantly across models. GPT-5 was the most linguistically complex but scored highest on PEMAT and GQS. Wenxin Yiyan was the most readable but generally scored lower on PEMAT and GQS. Prevention/rehabilitation and etiology topics were harder to read.
links.quote: GPT-5 generated the most linguistically complex responses but achieved the highest ratings for educational suitability and information quality.

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the readability, understandability, and educational quality of five LLMs answering patient questions about trigeminal neuralgia without evaluating an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
